title.en: GCSE results: girls still ahead but gender gap narrows as hundreds of thousands of pupils receive grades – latest updates
title.zh: 普通中等教育证书（GCSE）成绩公布：英格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰数十万学生收到成绩——最新进展

summary.en: Students across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland are receiving their GCSE results. A study indicates that compulsory GCSE resits in England negatively affect teenagers' mental well-being, prompting the government to review the resit policy.
summary.zh: 英格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰的学生正在收到他们的普通中等教育证书（GCSE）成绩。一项研究发现，英格兰强制性的GCSE补考损害了青少年的心理健康，促使政府正在考虑修改补考政策。

body.en: Nearly a quarter of girls’ entries received one of the higher grades against around a fifth of those from boys Almost one in four boys in England get top grades in maths Myles McGinley, managing director of the Cambridge OCR exam board, said more pupils are taking GCSE business studies than in previous years, describing this generation of young people as “increasingly entrepreneurial”. He said business studies entries are a third higher than five years ago, adding: “The founders of some of the next great unicorn businesses may well be among those achieving GCSEs in business studies today.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，英格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰的学生开始打开装有GCSE强制GCSE补考的信封，这会损害青少年的心理健康。露西·鲍威尔表示，政府正在考虑改变英格兰的补考政策，要求未在GCSE英语或数学中取得4级成绩的学生重新参加这些考试。正如《卫报》教育编辑理查德·亚当斯昨天报道的那样，研究表明英格兰的强制休学对青少年的心理健康产生了负面影响。您可以在这里阅读理查德的报告。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As young people face the pressures of academic results and compulsory resits, this news highlights the importance of educational systems that truly nurture their well-being. Yahweh's wisdom reminds us that how we guide and form the young profoundly shapes their future.
reflection.zh: 当年轻人面对学业成绩和强制补考的压力时，这则新闻强调了教育系统真正培养他们福祉的重要性。雅伟的智慧提醒我们，我们如何引导和塑造年轻人，将深刻影响他们的未来。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: Burnham announces plans to clean up illegal waste dumps – UK politics live
title.zh: 伯纳姆宣布计划清理非法垃圾场——英国政治直播

summary.en: The UK Prime Minister has announced plans to tackle illegal waste dumps operated by criminal gangs, promising a crackdown on those profiting from environmental harm.
summary.zh: 英国首相宣布计划打击由犯罪团伙经营的非法垃圾倾倒场，承诺严惩那些通过破坏环境牟利的人。

body.en: The prime minister has promised a crackdown on criminal gangs making money from dumping waste Value being generated by student loans is “not what it should be”, Reform UK’s deputy leader said. Asked by reporters about the funding of the scheme by stopping foreign students accessing loans, Richard Tice said: Regarding the funding of this, cash is cash. Whether you think that it’s cash as a positive in a balance sheet or a bank account, or whether you’re borrowing it, it’s money. It’s cash. As Suella quite rightly said, the amount of money going into student loans, it’s all government money, and this government is borrowing vast sums. In terms of Mickey Mouse courses, listen, this has been well-chronicled for many years. Whether it’s gender studies, whether it’s golf course studies, I think I’ve seen there’s not a necessity. There’s not a value in many of these degrees. Now I know that might be uncomfortable to those people who have those qualifications, but the reality is you’ve got to ask yourself: what are your graduate outcomes looking like? Continue reading...
body.zh: 总理承诺打击通过倾倒废物赚钱的犯罪团伙。在以色列发布在被占领的约旦河西岸建设定居点的招标后，外交大臣埃德·米利班德对以色列进行了谴责，称这是“不可接受的破坏性行为”。他表示，英国不会“退缩并接受两国解决方案被破坏”，并承诺在未来几周内制定措施应对以色列的政策。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The commitment to clean up illegal waste and confront criminal exploitation reflects a government's duty to uphold justice and protect its citizens and the environment. Yahweh calls leaders to do what is right and just, ensuring that the land and its people are not harmed by those who seek illicit gain. This action reminds us that true leadership involves...
reflection.zh: 清理非法垃圾并打击犯罪剥削的承诺，体现了政府维护正义、保护公民和环境的职责。雅伟呼召领袖行公义、做正直的事，确保土地和人民不被那些寻求不法利益的人所伤害。这一行动提醒我们，真正的领导力在于维护公共利益，并从那些剥削社区的人手中拯救他们。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Founder of China’s Evergrande jailed for life after pleading guilty to fraud
title.zh: 中国恒大创始人许家印认罪欺诈被判无期徒刑

summary.en: Hui Ka Yan, founder of China's Evergrande, a major property developer, has been sentenced to life in prison after pleading guilty to fraud. He will forfeit all personal property, and his company faces substantial fines.
summary.zh: 中国大型房地产开发商恒大集团创始人许家印因欺诈罪被判处无期徒刑。他所有个人财产将被没收，其公司也面临巨额罚款。

body.en: Hui Ka Yan also forfeits all his personal property and the company he set up is given hefty fines Business live – latest updates The founder of Evergrande, one of China’s largest property developers, has been sentenced to life in prison and had all of his personal property confiscated. Hui Ka Yan, 67 and once named by Forbes as China’s richest man, with a net worth of $42.5bn (£31.2bn) in 2017, pleaded guilty in April to eight charges. Continue reading...
body.zh: 许家印还被没收全部个人财产，他创办的公司被处以巨额罚款 商业直播 – 最新动态 中国最大的房地产开发商之一恒大集团的创始人被判处无期徒刑，并被没收全部个人财产。 67 岁的许家印曾被《福布斯》评为中国首富，2017 年净资产达 425 亿美元（312 亿英镑），他于 4 月承认了 8 项指控。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news reminds us of the profound dangers inherent in the pursuit of wealth above all else. When the love of money becomes the driving force, it can lead individuals down paths of deception and ultimately, self-destruction. Yahweh's word warns that such a path often brings many sorrows, a truth tragically illustrated here.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻提醒我们，将财富置于一切之上所带来的深远危险。当贪爱钱财成为主导力量时，它会引导个人走向欺骗之路，最终导致自我毁灭。雅伟的话语警告说，这样的道路常常带来许多愁苦，这在此事件中得到了悲剧性的印证。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: ‘Republicans ran up the tab’: Democrats outraged over $40tn national debt – live
title.zh: 民主党人对40万亿美元国债感到愤怒，称“共和党人欠下了这笔账”

summary.en: The US national debt has exceeded $40 trillion for the first time, having doubled over the past decade due to increased spending under both the Trump and Biden administrations.
summary.zh: 美国国债首次突破40万亿美元，在过去十年中，由于特朗普和拜登政府的支出增加，国债翻了一番。

body.en: US national deficit has doubled over the past decade with spending growing under Trump and Biden US gross national debt tops $40tn for first time Sign up for the US Breaking News email As the third leg of NBC’s Sunday Night Football crew alongside play-by-play man Al Michaels and the tart-tongued analyst Cris Collinsworth, Michele Tafoya was a paragon of deference and neutrality for 11 years as an NFL sideline reporter, dutifully relating boilerplate tactics, talking points and injury updates when she wasn’t nodding along to softball interviews or fumbling through hammy production gimmicks for viewers who might have been too offline to get the bit. She was almost pathologically committed to not doing anything to draw attention to herself or her gender in an era when sideline reporting was a fast track to national celebrity. Even her football takes hewed to the middle. (“New Orleans doesn’t want to lose to Atlanta twice in a season …”) Anyone who says they saw the 61-year-old emerging as a rightwing firebrand was watching a different game. Continue reading...
body.zh: 过去十年，随着特朗普和拜登的支出增长，美国国家赤字翻了一番 美国国家债务总额首次突破 40 万亿美元 订阅美国突发新闻电子邮件 作为 NBC 周日晚间橄榄球队的第三站，与实况报道员阿尔·迈克尔斯和尖酸刻薄的分析师克里斯·柯林斯沃思一起，米歇尔·塔福亚在担任 NFL 场边记者 11 年来，一直是顺从和中立的典范，尽职尽责地讲述了样板战术，谈论当她没有在垒球采访中点头或为那些可能太离线而无法理解的观众摸索着哈米制作花招时，她会得到分数和受伤情况的最新消息。在一个旁白报道是成为全国名人的捷径的时代，她几乎病态地致力于不做任何事情来引起人们对她自己或她的性别的关注。甚至她的足球也被砍到了中间。 （“新奥尔良不想在一个赛季内两次输给亚特兰大……”）任何说看到这位 61 岁的老将成为右翼煽动者的人都在观看另一场不同的比赛。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a soaring national debt reminds us of the long-term implications of financial choices, echoing the wisdom that "the borrower is slave to the lender." This situation calls for careful stewardship and a collective commitment to responsible financial practices, ensuring future generations are not unduly burdened.
reflection.zh: 国债飙升的消息提醒我们，财政选择具有长远影响，正如智慧所言：“借贷者是债主的奴仆。” 这种情况呼唤着谨慎的管家职分和对负责任的财政实践的集体承诺，以确保后代不会承受不必要的重担。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

Continue reading...

In such moments, Psalm 46:9 offers a profound hope, reminding us that Yahweh is the one who ultimately makes wars cease and brings an end to the instruments of destruction. It points to a future where peace will prevail, even when it...

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.

title.en: Former Liberian vice-president charged in drug-trafficking probe
title.zh: 利比里亚前副总统被控贩毒

summary.en: Jewel Howard-Taylor was arrested at Liberia's international airport and has not commented on the allegations.
summary.zh: Jewel Howard-Taylor在利比里亚国际机场被捕，尚未对指控发表评论。

body.en:
Liberia has charged former Vice-President Jewel Howard-Taylor with drug trafficking, money laundering and a range of other offences as part of an investigation into an alleged transnational narcotics network.

She was detained on Wednesday before being able to board a flight at Roberts International Airport in the capital, Monrovia, the country's justice ministry confirmed.

Police chief Gregory Coleman has linked her to the seizure last month of cocaine valued at $317m (£233m).

The 63-year-old politician has yet to make any public comment about the allegations. Her lawyer told the BBC he could not comment until Howard-Taylor was formally charged in court.

Howard-Taylor went into politics after her now ex-husband, former President Charles Taylor, left power. He was a former rebel leader who was elected Liberia's president in 1997, remaining in office until 2003.

Charles Taylor was later arrested and convicted by a UN-back court of aiding and abetting rebels in neighbouring Sierra Leone during the 1991-2002 civil war, in which some 50,000 people died.

Several years later, George Weah picked Howard-Taylor as his running mate and she served as his deputy during his presidency from 2018 until 2024.

Howard-Tayor faces charges including the unlicensed importation, sale and transportation of controlled drugs, illicit trafficking, criminal solicitation and criminal facilitation.

Police have charged three foreign nationals - two Croatians and one Ukrainian - in absentia as part of their investigation. They are accused of being part of the same network as the former politician.

Liberian Justice Minister Oswald Tweh said the authorities would use domestic and international measures to locate and arrest them.

Liberia has stepped up a crackdown on cocaine trafficking, following two major seizures in June and July.

Almost four tonnes of cocaine believed to be bound for Europe were found during the raid in July.

The authorities described it as Liberia's biggest drug bust and said it had uncovered a sophisticated transnational trafficking network.

The investigation has since extended to senior figures within Liberia's security establishment.

The government says its investigations are aimed at identifying not only those directly involved in transporting drugs, but also financiers, organisers and people accused of helping to protect the operation.

"No office is too high, no political connection is too powerful, no nationality provides immunity, and no individual is beyond the reach of the law," it said in a statement.

West Africa has increasingly been used as a major transit route for cocaine trading from South America to Europe, with traffickers exploiting porous borders and weak enforcement in parts of the region.
body.zh: 作为对涉嫌跨国毒品网络调查的一部分，利比里亚指控前副总统朱厄尔·霍华德·泰勒犯有贩毒、洗钱和一系列其他罪行。 该国司法部证实，她于周三在首都蒙罗维亚罗伯茨国际机场登机前被拘留。 警察局长格雷戈里·科尔曼将她与上个月缉获的价值 3.17 亿美元（2.33 亿英镑）的可卡因联系起来。 这位 63 岁的政治家尚未对这些指控发表任何公开评论。 BBC 已联系她的律师征求意见。 霍华德·泰勒在她的前夫、前总统查尔斯·泰勒下台后进入政界。他是前叛乱领导人，1997 年当选利比里亚总统，任期至 2003 年。 查尔斯·泰勒后来被联合国支持的法庭逮捕并定罪，罪名是在 1991 年至 2002 年内战期间协助和教唆邻国塞拉利昂的叛乱分子，这场战争造成约 5 万人死亡。 几年后，乔治·维阿选择霍华德·泰勒作为他的竞选搭档，而她在 2018 年至 2024 年的总统任期内担任他的副手。 霍华德-泰尔面临的指控包括未经许可进口、销售和运输受管制毒品、非法贩运、教唆犯罪和协助犯罪。 作为调查的一部分，警方缺席指控了三名外国人——两名克罗地亚人和一名乌克兰人。他们被指控与前政客属于同一网络。 利比里亚司法部长奥斯瓦尔德·特韦表示，当局将利用国内和国际措施来查找和逮捕他们。 利比里亚继 6 月和 7 月缉获了两次大宗可卡因之后，加大了对可卡因贩运的打击力度。 7 月份的突袭行动中发现了近四吨据信运往欧洲的可卡因。 当局称这是利比里亚最大的一次缉毒行动，并称其破获了一个复杂的跨国贩运网络。 此后调查范围已扩大到利比里亚安全机构内的高级人物。 政府表示，调查的目的不仅是查明那些直接参与毒品运输的人，还包括金融家、组织者和被指控帮助保护毒品运输的人。 它在一份声明中表示：“没有太高的职位，没有太强大的政治关系，没有国籍可以提供豁免，没有任何个人可以不受法律管辖。” 西非越来越多地被用作从南美洲到欧洲的可卡因贸易的主要过境路线，贩运者利用该地区部分地区的边境漏洞和执法薄弱。

reflection.en: The news of a former high-ranking official facing drug-trafficking charges reminds us of the powerful allure of illicit gain. Yahweh's word warns that the love of money can lead to various evils, even for those entrusted with public service. This serves as a sober reminder of the constant need for integrity and accountability in all positions of influence.
reflection.zh: 一位前高级官员面临贩毒指控的消息，提醒我们非法所得的巨大诱惑。雅伟的话语警告我们，贪爱钱财是万恶之根，即使是那些受托服务公众的人也不例外。这警醒我们，在所有有影响力的高位上，都需要持续的正直和问责。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: At least 15 killed in Kyiv as Ukraine grapples with air defence shortages
title.zh: 基辅遭袭致至少12人死亡，乌克兰面临防空短缺

summary.en: Officials reported that at least 12 people were killed in Kyiv after apartment blocks and warehouses were targeted in a massive attack on Thursday, as Ukraine continues to face shortages in its air defense capabilities.
summary.zh: 官员称，周四基辅遭到“大规模袭击”，公寓楼和仓库成为目标，造成至少12人死亡。乌克兰正面临防空能力短缺的问题。

body.en:
At least 15 people have been killed in the latest Russian strikes targeting the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv's mayor said, as Ukraine continues to face a shortage of air defence missiles.

Apartment blocks and warehouses were struck across the city overnight, the State Emergency Service of Ukraine said, while a children's hospital and school were also damaged.

The deaths were the result of a shortage of air defence missiles, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said, which Kyiv relies on western allies to supply.

Speaking to BBC News at a wrecked apartment block in Kyiv, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said Ukraine needed "ammunition, anti-missile systems - we need support from our partners".

Klitschko was in Solomianskyi district to assess the damage. Around him, emergency workers continued to sift through rubble and people stood outside their destroyed homes.

Among them was Valeria Bondaruk, who moved to Kyiv after her home in southern Ukraine was bombed, believing it would be safer for her and her daughter.

A shard of glass embedded in her bedroom wall served as a sign of how close this was. She hid in a hallway overnight as they have no bomb shelter.

She told the BBC she fears for her 13-year-old daughter's future and is considering leaving Ukraine.

Ukrainian MP Oleksiy Goncharenko told the BBC that Ukraine is "absolutely unprotected" from ballistic missile attacks and "can't do anything" without interceptors.

Speaking to BBC Radio 4's Today programme, he said: "Russia is using this trying to destroy as much infrastructure as possible.

"For us it's very painful because we are dying here every day without these interceptors."

Writing on Telegram, Zelensky said "as long as Ukraine does not have enough anti-ballistics, Russia will not seriously think about peace".

He added: "The interceptors for the Patriots have not yet been replaced, and they are needed every day. Each additional missile saves the lives of our people."

An update released by the Ukrainian Air Force on Thursday morning implied that none of the Russian ballistic missiles used overnight were intercepted.

The Russian defence ministry said it used air, land and sea-based weapons to target military facilities and warehouses.

Ukraine has relied on American supplies of Patriot interceptor missiles to combat Russian ballistic missiles, but the US has used much of its stockpile during the war in the Middle East and has been supplying Ukraine with less.

Zelensky's renewed plea for more military aid came as he faced a direct political challenge from the popular ex-defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov, who has called for an election and launched a scathing attack on the government by claiming corruption has deprived the military of weapons .

The latest strikes on Kyiv began around midnight...
body.zh: 俄罗斯最近针对乌克兰首都的袭击已造成至少 12 人死亡、34 人受伤，基辅仍然面临防空导弹短缺的问题。 乌克兰国家紧急服务局（DSNS）表示，整座城市的公寓楼和仓库一夜之间遭到袭击，儿童医院和学校也遭到破坏。 俄罗斯国防部表示，他们使用空基、陆基和海基武器瞄准军事设施和仓库。 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基表示，死亡事件是由于防空导弹短缺造成的，基辅依靠西方盟友提供防空导弹。 他在 Telegram 上写道，“只要乌克兰没有足够的反弹道导弹，俄罗斯就不会认真考虑和平”。 他补充道：“爱国者导弹的拦截弹尚未更换，而且每天都需要它们。每增加一枚导弹都可以拯救我们人民的生命。” 乌克兰一直依赖美国提供的爱国者拦截导弹来对抗俄罗斯弹道导弹，但美国在中东战争期间使用了其大部分库存，并且向乌克兰提供的导弹数量较少。 乌克兰周四上午发布的最新消息暗示，夜间使用的俄罗斯弹道导弹没有被拦截。 泽连斯基再次呼吁提供更多军事援助之际，他面临着受欢迎的前国防部长米哈伊洛·费多罗夫的直接政治挑战。费多罗夫呼吁举行选举，并声称腐败剥夺了军队的武器，对政府发起严厉攻击。 对基辅的最新一次袭击始于当地时间午夜左右，当时全城响起了空袭警报，随后大约 20 枚俄罗斯导弹袭击了基辅。 袭击导致数千处房屋断电，基辅地区部分地区陷入黑暗。 乌克兰空军表示，俄罗斯在这次袭击中动用了168架无人机和44枚导弹，主要针对基辅，并补充说防空系统击落了146架无人机和39枚巡航导弹。 在更广阔的基辅地区其他地方，布罗瓦里和鲍里斯波尔地区发生的袭击造成 1 人死亡、7 人受伤。当地官员称，顿涅茨克州已造成 1 人死亡、11 人受伤。 俄罗斯国防部表示，726架乌克兰无人机在全国多个地区发射后被击落。 罗马尼亚国防部表示，一架无人机进入其北部与乌克兰边境的领土，引发空中警报，然后坠入“无人居住区”。 波兰军方还表示，已启动“防御性空中行动”以保护其领空。 最近几周，战争双方都进行了大规模空袭，造成数十人死亡。 乌克兰加强了深度攻击……

reflection.en: In the wake of such devastating attacks and ongoing vulnerability, the human spirit can feel overwhelmed. Psalm 46:1 reminds us that Yahweh is an ever-present refuge and strength, offering solace and help even amidst the deepest troubles. This promise can anchor hearts facing fear and loss, knowing divine presence is near.
reflection.zh: 面对如此毁灭性的袭击和持续的脆弱，人的心灵可能会感到不堪重负。诗篇46:1提醒我们，雅伟是我们随时的避难所和力量，即使在最深的困境中也提供安慰和帮助。这个应许能安定那些面对恐惧和失落的心，知道雅伟的同在就在身边。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: South Africa's ANC faces voter backlash
title.zh: 南非非国大面临选民强烈反对

summary.en: Anti-migrant violence, economic stagnation and corruption allegations are eroding support for South Africa's ruling ANC ahead of local elections in November, opening the door to new coalition possibilities.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Anti-migrant violence, economic stagnation and corruption allegations are eroding support for South Africa's ruling ANC ahead of local elections in November, opening the door to new coalition possibilities.

Impassable roads, crater-like potholes, burst water pipes, mountains of trash, and grinding poverty are part of everyday life in South Africa's communities. So too are unemployment, hunger, and crime.

The latest wave of violence targeting foreign nationals has claimed several lives since April and  forced more than 176,000 people to flee South Africa, most of them returning to their home countries of neighboring Zimbabwe, Malawi and Mozambique.

At the recently concluded  Southern African Development Community (SADC)  summit in Durban, the vigilante group March and March again called for migrants to leave South Africa .

"Come and take your people back," its members urged the governments of neighboring countries, while police moved to contain the protests.

South African President Cyril Ramaphosa  said ahead of the summit that he was "concerned and ashamed" that citizens of other countries had been subjected to abuse and violence and had been forced to flee.

According to Fredson Guilengue of the Rosa Luxemburg Foundation, growing anti-migrant sentiment is a symptom of deeper public discontent.

"This reflects their frustration, particularly with the ANC's failure at both the national and local levels to create jobs, tackle inequality, reduce crime and improve living conditions," Guilengue told DW. "In the [November 4] elections, South Africans will express their deep frustration over the lack of public services, inadequate infrastructure and poverty."

The African National Congress (ANC), Nelson Mandela's former liberation party , is on course to perform even worse than in the 2024 general election , when it suffered a historic setback, winning 40.2% of the vote, Guilengue notes.

According to Guilengue, the November elections are unlikely to go in the ANC's favor, as little has changed for the better since the last election . In other words, unemployment remains very high, as do crime rates and corruption.

"These problems have not been resolved over the years and have become entrenched in South African society. The municipalities have been governed by the ANC, and there has been widespread mismanagement alongside a steady deterioration of infrastructure. That has generated enormous public anger," he added.

Voters are expected to turn to opposition parties, including the main opposition Democratic Alliance (DA), a party supported primarily by white voters and one that has been part of a government of national unity with the ANC since 2024.

body.zh: 在 11 月份地方选举之前，反移民暴力、经济停滞和腐败指控正在削弱南非执政党非国大的支持率，为新的联合政府打开了大门。 无法通行的道路、火山口般的坑洼、爆裂的水管、堆积如山的垃圾和极度贫困是南非社区日常生活的一部分。失业、饥饿和犯罪也是如此。 自 4 月以来，最新一波针对外国人的暴力事件已造成多人死亡，并迫使超过 176,000 人逃离南非，其中大多数人返回邻国津巴布韦、马拉维和莫桑比克。 最近在德班结束的南部非洲发展共同体 (SADC) 峰会上，治安组织 March 和 March 再次呼吁移民离开南非。 其成员敦促邻国政府“快来带你的人民回来”，而警方则采取行动遏制抗议活动。 南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨在峰会前表示，他对其他国家的公民遭受虐待和暴力并被迫逃离感到“担忧和羞愧”。 罗莎·卢森堡基金会的弗莱德森·吉伦格表示，日益高涨的反移民情绪是公众不满情绪加深的表现。 吉伦格告诉德国之声：“这反映了他们的挫败感，特别是非国大在国家和地方层面未能创造就业机会、解决不平等问题、减少犯罪和改善生活条件。” “在 [11 月 4 日] 选举中，南非人将表达对缺乏公共服务、基础设施不足和贫困的深深沮丧。” Guilengue 指出，纳尔逊·曼德拉 (Nelson Mandela) 的前解放党非洲人国民大会 (ANC) 的表现可能会比 2024 年大选更糟糕，当时它赢得了 40.2% 的选票，遭遇历史性挫折。 吉伦格表示，11 月的选举不太可能对非国大有利，因为自上次选举以来，情况几乎没有什么好转。换句话说，失业率仍然很高，犯罪率和腐败率也很高。 “这些问题多年来一直没有得到解决，并在南非社会中根深蒂固。这些城市一直由非国大管理，管理不善，基础设施不断恶化，普遍存在管理不善的情况。这引起了公众的巨大愤怒，”他补充道。 预计选民将转向反对党，包括主要反对党民主联盟 (DA)，该党主要由白人选民支持，自 2024 年以来一直是与非洲人国民大会组成的民族团结政府的一部分。 令人惊讶的是，开普敦前市长海伦·齐勒（Helen Zille）被称为……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Ecuador intelligence chief and five Americans killed in Kenya helicopter crash
title.zh: 厄瓜多尔情报局长和五名美国人在肯尼亚直升机坠毁事故中丧生

summary.en: A helicopter crash in Kenya resulted in the deaths of seven people, including Ecuador's intelligence chief and five Americans. Among the victims were Michele Sensi-Contugi and his wife Stephany Hollihan.
summary.zh: 一架直升机在肯尼亚坠毁，造成七人死亡，其中包括厄瓜多尔情报局长和五名美国人。遇难者中包括米歇尔·森西-孔图吉和他的妻子斯蒂芬妮·霍利汉。

body.en:
Ecuador's intelligence chief and his wife have been killed in a helicopter that crashed at Mount Ololokwe in central Kenya.

Michele Sensi-Contugi, 44, and his wife, fashion designer Stephany Hollihan, 42, were among the group of seven people - six tourists and the pilot - killed in Samburu county at approximately 09:13 (06:13 GMT) on Wednesday.

Five of victims were Americans, a US State Department spokesperson said. The Reuters news agency reports that Hollihan also held US citizenship.

The Kenya Civil Aviation Authority (KCAA) said the helicopter was on a scenic flight from a wildlife conservancy in Loisaba to Ewaso Nyiro, a river that flows along several national reserves.

Samburu county is a popular tourist destination with many private wildlife conservancies and is renowned for its stunning landscape.

Images from the scene show smoke at the wooded crash site on Mount Ololokwe, as members of the Kenya Red Cross approach the still-burning wreckage.

Ecuador's President Daniel Noboa named Sensi-Contugo director of the country's Centre of Strategic Intelligence (CIES) in January 2024.

The office of the president and Ecuador's National Assembly expressed their condolences over his death and that of Hollihan.

The Italian-Ecuadorean businessman had had close links to Noboa even before he was chosen to lead the intelligence service and was considered a close ally of the president.

Shortly before being named head of the CIES, he had served for four months as a minister in his cabinet.

Newspapers in Ecuador have also run obituaries of Hollihan. The Guayaquil-based designer founded Sensi Studio, a brand praised for incorporating traditional Ecuadorean elements and materials in its designs.

Lady Lori Helicopters, which operated the Eurocopter EC130 B4 aircraft, said it was "deeply saddened" by the accident.

"Our deepest sympathies are with the guests, crew, their families and loved ones, and all those affected by this tragic accident," a statement read.

According to a memo seen by the BBC's US partner CBS News , external one of the Americans killed in the crash was NBCUniversal journalist José Alberto Suárez.

In the memo, NBCUniversal called Suárez "a deeply respected leader and beloved friend and colleague.

Miami restaurateur Roger Duarte was among the Americans killed in the crash, according to local and US media.

Commenting on his death on X, US Rep Carlos Antonio Gimenez wrote: "Our prayers are with their loved ones during this incredibly difficult time. May their memories be a blessing."

In February, a helicopter crash in the Rift Valley county of Nandi killed six people, including a member of parliament.

body.zh: 厄瓜多尔情报局长和他的妻子在肯尼亚中部奥洛洛奎山坠毁的直升机中丧生。 周三上午 9 点 13 分（格林威治标准时间 06 点 13 分）左右，44 岁的米歇尔·森西-孔图吉 (Michele Sensi-Contugi) 和他 42 岁的妻子、时装设计师斯蒂芬妮·霍利汉 (Stephany Hollihan) 等七人（六名游客和一名飞行员）在桑布鲁县遇难。 美国国务院发言人表示，其中五名受害者是美国人。路透社报道称，霍利汉还拥有美国公民身份。 肯尼亚民航局（KCAA）表示，这架直升机正在从洛伊萨巴野生动物保护区飞往埃瓦索尼罗河（Ewaso Nyiro）的观光飞行中，埃瓦索尼罗河是一条流经多个国家保护区的河流。 桑布鲁县是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地，拥有许多私人野生动物保护区，并以其令人惊叹的景观而闻名。 现场图像显示，当肯尼亚红十字会成员接近仍在燃烧的残骸时，奥洛洛奎山树木繁茂的坠机现场冒出浓烟。 厄瓜多尔总统丹尼尔·诺博亚于 2024 年 1 月任命 Sensi-Contugo 为该国战略情报中心 (CIES) 主任。 总统办公室和厄瓜多尔国民议会对他和霍利汉的去世表示哀悼。 这位意大利裔厄瓜多尔裔商人甚至在被选为情报部门领导之前就与诺博亚有着密切的联系，并被认为是总统的亲密盟友。 在被任命为 CIES 主席之前不久，他曾在内阁担任部长四个月。 厄瓜多尔的报纸也刊登了霍利汉的讣告。这位瓜亚基尔设计师创立了 Sensi Studio，该品牌因在设计中融入厄瓜多尔传统元素和材料而受到赞誉。 运营欧洲直升机公司 EC130 B4 飞机的 Lady Lori Helicopters 表示，对这起事故“深感悲痛”。 一份声明中写道：“我们向客人、船员、他们的家人和亲人以及所有受到这场悲惨事故影响的人表示最深切的同情。” 根据BBC美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻网看到的一份备忘录，在此次事故中丧生的美国人之一是NBC环球记者何塞·阿尔贝托·苏亚雷斯。 在备忘录中，NBCUniversal 称苏亚雷斯是“一位深受尊敬的领导人、挚爱的朋友和同事。 据当地和美国媒体报道，迈阿密餐馆老板罗杰·杜阿尔特是在此次事故中丧生的美国人之一。 美国众议员卡洛斯·安东尼奥·吉梅内斯 (Carlos Antonio Gimenez) 在 X 上评论他的去世时写道：“在这个极其困难的时刻，我们为他们的亲人祈祷。愿他们的回忆成为祝福。” 2月，南迪裂谷县发生的一次直升机坠毁事件造成六人死亡，其中包括一名议员。 2024 年，一架载有 11 人的军用直升机在阿富汗坠毁，军事首长弗朗西斯·奥蒙迪·奥古拉 (Francis Omondi Ogolla) 将军身亡。

Yet, for those who trust in Yahweh, there is a profound hope that one day, all tears will be wiped away, and suffering will be no more. This promise offers solace in moments of deep grief, pointing to a future where sorrow is...
reflection.zh: 这场悲剧性事故中生命的突然逝去，提醒我们世间生命的脆弱和死亡带来的痛苦。然而，对于那些信靠雅伟的人，有一个深刻的盼望，就是有一天，所有的眼泪都将被擦去，苦难将不复存在。这个应许在深切的悲痛时刻带来慰藉，指向一个悲伤被胜过的未来。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: How DW fact-checks fake news
title.zh: 德国之声如何对假新闻进行事实核查

summary.en: Disinformation spreads fast. Step inside DW's fact-checking process and see how the team puts online claims to the test.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.zh: 虚假信息传播得很快。走进德国之声的事实核查流程，看看该团队如何对网上的说法进行测试。 虚假和误导性的说法可以在几分钟内传播到世界各地，使得区分事实与虚构变得越来越困难。 在虚假说法比事实传播得更快的时代，独立验证至关重要。 这就是 DW 事实核查的用武之地。请允许我们自我介绍并解释更多有关我们工作的信息。 这可以包括政治家、政府官员和政党的声明，以及涉及名人、运动员、商界领袖和非营利组织的声明。 我们验证在主要社交媒体平台上疯传的图像、视频或音频的真实性。 我们还越来越多地调查广泛共享的内容是否真实，或者是否是使用人工智能生成或操纵的。 在 DW Fact check 中，我们会调查索赔的来源、出现的时间和地点、是否被操纵以及背后的支持者。 只要有可能，我们都会追踪主张的原始来源并检查支持它们的证据。然后，我们将声明与可靠的数据、文件和专家评估进行比较，以确定其准确性。 为了对信息进行事实核查，我们使用一系列开源情报 (OSINT) 工具和验证技术。 DW 创建了一个专门的网站，您可以在其中详细了解我们经常使用的验证工作流程和工具。在那里，您可以探索验证图像、视频、录音、来源和基于文本的声明的方法。 透明度是我们工作的重要组成部分。每项事实核查都尽可能包含指向我们报道中使用的来源的超链接，使读者能够查看我们记者所依赖的相同证据。 与德国之声的所有新闻一样，我们的事实核查基于通过可靠且独立的来源验证的信息。 只要有可能，我们都会遵循双源原则，并从多个来源寻求确认。 在从采访合作伙伴那里获取信息时，我们始终选择可靠且公正的人员。经访谈对象同意后，所有访谈都会被记录并存档。 我们会按姓名和职业提及所有消息来源，并在可能的情况下提供其联系信息的链接，以保证透明度。 仅在极少数情况下，当消息来源的安全受到威胁或主题敏感时，才会授予消息来源匿名。在这些情况下，我们对匿名的原因保持透明。 DW 使用协作流程来评估索赔并确定判决。 在发布之前，...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to truth, discernment, and honest speech. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with discernment and truthful speech, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到真理、分辨与诚实。Philippians 4:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以分辨与诚实表达来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Four workers dead after being hit by train in Japan
title.zh: 日本四名工人被火车撞死

summary.en: Authorities report that four workers were killed after being struck by a train at Shin-Kanuma Station, north of Tokyo.
summary.zh: 当局称，在东京以北的新鹿沼站，一列火车撞上四名工人，导致他们死亡。

body.en:
Four workers in Japan have died after being struck by a train at Shin-Kanuma Station, north of Tokyo, authorities say.

The collision happened around 10:46 local time (01:46 GMT) Thursday while the workers were spraying herbicide, said Tobu Railway, the operator of the line.

Police are investigating if safety guidelines were followed when the accident happened, Tobu Railway officials told a press conference.

Train service was suspended on the Tobu Nikko Line due to the accident, according to Tobu Railway.

A passenger on the train told Japanese public broadcaster NHK that they heard a "strange noise" before the train made an emergency stop.

He said passengers were stuck on the train for a while as staff announced that they were investigating the noise.

Fatal train accidents are rare in Japan, which relies on a sprawling railway network.

The train involved in Thursday's incident was a limited express train, according to NHK. These are the second-fastest trains in Japan, after the Shinkansen or bullet train.

The fatalities, who were in their 50s and 60s, were among a team of ten working at the site on Thursday, railway officials said.

The team also included a supervisor and three lookouts tasked with alerting workers to incoming trains.

The lookouts generally use whistles and microphones to alert the workers, while waving a yellow flag at the train driver.

When asked repeatedly if anyone had been looking out for trains ahead of the accident, the officials did not give clear answers.

A Tobu Railway representative told the BBC earlier that the " usual lookout system was operating as normal".

"When a train approaches, a lookout waves a flag and, once the driver acknowledges it, sounds the horn," he said.

Tobu Railway general manager Takao Suzuki said the company offered "our deepest condolences to those who lost their lives and heartfelt apologies to their families".

"We also deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused to all those involved and to our customers," he said.

title.en: Israel opens up bids for highly sensitive West Bank settlement project
title.zh: 以色列就高度敏感的约旦河西岸定居点项目公开招标

summary.en: Israel has initiated a tender process for a new settlement project in the West Bank. The UK's foreign secretary has publicly condemned this action, describing it as "an unacceptable and destructive act."
summary.zh: 以色列已启动在约旦河西岸一项新定居点项目的招标程序。英国外交大臣公开谴责此举，称其为“不可接受且具有破坏性的行为”。

body.en:
Israel has opened up tenders for the construction of some 1,200 settlement homes in a strategically important part of the occupied West Bank, as the government seeks to end any chance of a Palestinian state.

Plans to build on the so-called E1 area - east of Jerusalem - have long been internationally condemned, with settlements illegal under international law.

The development would in effect divide the West Bank in two and isolate East Jerusalem.

UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has condemned the publication of a tender as "an unacceptable and destructive act", and called on Israel to "halt E1 plans immediately, retract the tender and stop all settlement expansion".

Israel's foreign minister responded harshly to Miliband's statement, which he said he "reject[ed] outright".

Israel has built about 160 settlements housing 700,000 Jews since it occupied the West Bank and East Jerusalem - land Palestinians want, along with Gaza, for a hoped-for future state - during the 1967 Middle East war. An estimated 3.3 million Palestinians live alongside them.

Despite the fierce international opposition, successive Israeli governments have allowed settlements to grow.

However, expansion has risen sharply since Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu returned to power in late 2022 at the head of a right-wing, pro-settler coalition, as well as the start of the Gaza war, triggered by Hamas's 7 October 2023 attack on Israel.

Under international pressure, Israel held off for decades on plans to build in E1.

Many of its allies and Palestinians argued these would deal a major blow to hopes of a two-state solution, effectively bisecting the West Bank.

But the current Israeli government gave the go-ahead for E1 construction a year ago, expressly to "erase" the idea of a Palestinian state.

Despite an Israeli court challenge to the plans by Bedouin Palestinians living in the area and Israeli peace groups, the housing ministry has now issued a tender for 1,234 of the 3,401 housing units approved by the Israeli government last August.

It covers about 12 sq km (4.6 sq miles) between East Jerusalem and the settlement of Maale Adumim.

At the time of their unveiling, Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich - an ultranationalist and settler - said the idea of a Palestinian state was "being erased".

The deadline for bids is 19 October, just days before Israel's general election on 27 October , making it much harder for any future government to overturn any tenders issued.

In a statement published on Wednesday evening, the UK's foreign secretary said "Britain will not stand back and accept the destruction of the Two-State Solution".

body.en:
The launch came hours after US President Trump announced plans to meet Kim Jong Un later this year.

North Korea fired around 10 short-range ballistic missiles toward the sea on Thursday, South Korea's military said.

Seoul's Joint Chiefs of Staff said the North fired the missiles "from its Pyongyang area."

Earlier, the Japanese prime minister's office and the country's Coast Guard also said they detected the suspected launch.

The incident came hours after US President Donald Trump said he would meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un later this year.

The latest missile launches also come as South Korea and the US continue military drills that are set to end Friday after  Trump's order to significantly reduce US participation .

Pyongyang has long denounced US-South Korea joint exercises as invasion rehearsals, often responding with missile launches.

"These exercises are not only costly, with much of these costs paid for by the United States of America (as usual!), but send a signal that is totally inappropriate and hostile, to a country that, as long as Donald J. Trump has been president, has been unthreatening and respectful," he wrote on Truth Social.

Kim Yo Jong , the influential sister of Kim Jong Un, dismissed Trump’s move, saying, "The provocative, aggressive nature of the drills won't change even though their duration and size were reduced."

"If the US calculates that it can propagate its recent measure as the one of so-called good faith, they will not get the desired answer," she added.

title.en: Bangladesh lawmakers elect BNP's Alamgir as president
title.zh: 孟加拉国议员选举民族主义党阿拉姆吉尔为总统

summary.en: Lawmakers in Bangladesh have elected a longtime opposition figure, Alamgir of the BNP party, as president. His party came to power following a 2024 revolution that led to the ousting of the previous government led by Sheikh Hasina.
summary.zh: 孟加拉国议员选举长期反对派人物、民族主义党（BNP）的阿拉姆吉尔为总统。他的政党是在2024年推翻谢赫·哈西娜政府的革命后上台的。

body.en:
The longtime opposition figure's party came to power after the 2024 revolution, which ousted the government of Sheikh Hasina.

Bangladesh's parliament elected ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) Secretary General, Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, as the country's new president on Thursday.

The BNP, which holds more than a two-thirds majority in parliament, secured the largely ceremonial post for Alamgir, defeating retired army officer-turned-politician Oli Ahmed of the opposition Jamaat-e-Islami-led alliance.

The election comes after former president Mohammed Shahabuddin, a close ally of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina , resigned in July citing health concerns.

In February, Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's BNP won a landslide victory in the first election since Hasina's 2024 ouster.

The party used its majority to hand the 78-year-old Alamgir the largely ceremonial presidency.

"I never thought that I would become the president, it is the infinite grace of the party and almighty Allah," he told reporters on Tuesday, according to the state news agency BSS.

"Even after becoming president, I wish to remain beside the people and serve them."

Alamgir was repeatedly arrested under Hasina's government, facing dozens of charges he said were politically motivated.

He has been hailed in the media for "keeping the BNP organized and maintaining the party's political presence during difficult times," referring to Hasina's rule.

title.en: From royal exit to return: The story behind Harry and Meghan's Atlantic crossing
title.zh: 从王室退出到回归：哈里和梅根跨越大西洋背后的故事

summary.en: Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan, are set to return to the UK, marking a surprising move after more than six years living abroad.
summary.zh: 哈里王子和他的妻子梅根在海外生活了六年多后，将出人意料地搬回英国。

body.en:
Six years after stepping down as working royals, Prince Harry and his wife Meghan Markle are moving back to the United Kingdom within weeks, British press reported on Thursday.

In a surprise move, Harry, the youngest son of King Charles III, and his wife "plan to leave the United States by the end of the month to settle in a private, non-royal residence, which is said to be located outside London", The Telegraph reported.

Several UK news outlets, including the BBC, reported the couple's two children, Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5, had already been enrolled in a British school for the start of the school year in early September.

It was reported that the couple had already chosen a new house, but that it would not be one of the many royal residences.

Harry and Meghan have lived in California since stepping down as working royals in 2020 and the children had not seen their grandfather Charles since 2022.

Harry, 41, and Meghan, 45, left the UK for North America in 2020 amid a bitter feud with his family, which worsened as Harry published his tell-all memoir Spare.

A no-holds-barred interview with US talk show host Oprah Winfrey also deepened the rift.

The BBC said the 77-year-old Charles had been made aware on Sunday that the Duke and Duchess of Sussex planned to return to live in the UK.

The monarch welcomes the opportunity to see more of the Sussex family in a private and personal capacity, but there will be no expected change to the couple's official status, the BBC reported.

While no official reason for the move has been shared, the news comes only weeks after Harry and Meghan paid a short visit to the UK in early July with the children, during which they had a private meeting with Charles.

Harry said last year that he wanted to reconcile with his father, who was diagnosed two years ago with cancer and has been receiving treatment since. The type of cancer has never been revealed.

It was not immediately clear whether Harry's older brother and heir to the throne, Prince William, and his wife, Catherine, had been told of the news. The two brothers have become estranged and reportedly no longer talk.

The UK's Sun newspaper reported the couple would keep their Montecito home in California.

While the couple signed a mega deal with Netflix in 2020 — reportedly worth an unconfirmed US$100 million ($140 million) — many of their projects have struggled to win over audiences.

title.en: 'I get along with him': Trump says he'll meet with North Korea's Kim Jong-un
title.zh: 特朗普称“我与他相处融洽”，表示将与朝鲜领导人金正恩会面

summary.en: Former President Trump announced his willingness to meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, stating they "get along." In an unusual disclosure, he also specified the number of warheads he believes North Korea possesses.
summary.zh: 前总统特朗普表示愿意与朝鲜领导人金正恩会面，称他们“相处融洽”。他还在一次不同寻常的披露中，具体指出了他认为朝鲜拥有的核弹头数量。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump says he ‌plans to meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, saying that the Asian ‌nation holds 57 "very powerful" nuclear weapons.

The remarks come as Trump ordered Pentagon officials to ‌cut short joint exercises with the South Korean military.

He wrote in a Sunday social media post that they sent a message to North Korea that was "totally inappropriate and hostile, to a Country that, as long as Donald J. Trump has been President, ‌has been unthreatening and ‌respectful".

During Trump's ⁠first term, Kim called Trump a "mentally deranged US dotard" and threatened that he had use of a "nuclear button" on his desk.

But the two leaders turned that tension into face-to-face meetings, including a brief exchange at the demilitarised zone between the Koreas in which Trump became the first sitting US president to step into North Korean territory.

The leaders' relationship cooled after the face-to-face meetings in 2018 and 2019 .

"I ‌know Kim Jong-un very well, and he's going to be fine as long as we have ‌a smart president," Trump told reporters during a tour of the helipad he is constructing on the White House's historic south lawn.

"I get along with him well," Trump said. "And you know what? The fact that I get along with him, that’s a very good thing, not a bad thing."

"He has 57 very powerful nuclear weapons They should have ‌never allowed it. If I were president, I wouldn't have allowed it. But he's got them," Trump said.

Trump's citing of a specific number of nuclear weapons held by North Korea was highly unusual.

There have been varying estimates by experts over the years on how many nuclear weapons North Korea has.

The US government does not publicly publish an official estimate of North Korea's nuclear arsenal, although a 2025 report by the Congressional Research Service cited non-governmental experts as estimating that North Korea has produced enough fissile material for up to 90 warheads but may have assembled approximately 50.

In June, the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute estimated that North Korea has "possibly assembled around 60 warheads, possesses enough fissile material to produce at ⁠least 30 more".

title.en: 'Power of the purse': What Trump stands to lose in US midterm test
title.zh: “钱袋子”的力量：特朗普在美国中期选举中可能失去什么

summary.en: As midterm primaries continue with elections in several states this week, analysts are predicting a shake-up in the political landscape, indicating potential shifts in influence for former President Trump.
summary.zh: 随着本周几个州中期初选的继续进行，分析人士预测政治格局将发生变化，预示着前总统特朗普的影响力可能出现转变。

body.en:
The 2026 United States midterm elections will be a crucial test of Donald Trump's political strength, with Democrats hoping to regain control of Congress and Republicans seeking to defy the historical tendency for a president's party to lose ground halfway through a term.

The November elections will determine control of the House of Representatives and could reshape the balance of power in Washington for the final two years of Trump's presidency.

The first midterm primaries were held in March and have continued in recent months, with Alaska, Florida and Wyoming holding their primaries this week.

For Democrats, the November midterms offer an opportunity to demonstrate that dissatisfaction with Trump can translate into electoral gains and to begin rebuilding the party ahead of the next general election in 2028.

For Republicans, the elections will test whether Trump's political strength remains sufficient to protect the party from the historical midterm backlash that has affected many previous administrations.

And for Trump himself, a Democratic-controlled House could mean substantially greater scrutiny, investigations and political resistance during the final years of his presidency.

Wesley Widmaier, a professor at the Australian National University Department of International Relations, told SBS News an overall loss for Trump would restrict his influence.

"The House controls the power of the purse and is where budgets originate in the American system. A Democrat win would mean a loss of a lot of control for Trump," he said.

Ultimately, the midterms could provide the clearest indication yet of whether the political momentum in the US is shifting away from Trump and the Republican Party — or whether Republicans can defy the historical pattern and maintain their grip on Congress.

Every two years, US citizens elect all 435 members of the House of Representatives, while roughly one-third of the Senate is elected.

The House of Representatives has the special power to initiate tax bills and to impeach officials, while the Senate approves presidential appointments, such as judges and cabinet members.

Unlike in Australia, voting in US elections is not compulsory, and midterm elections — those held between presidential elections — tend to have lower voter turnout and less media attention.

But Widmaier said they still have significance for US politics and decision-making.

Historically, the president's party tends to lose ground in the House during midterm elections, he explained.

title.en: Donald Trump says no Iran talks planned, shares map showing Hormuz as 'new US territory'
title.zh: 特朗普称未计划与伊朗谈判，并分享地图将霍尔木兹海峡标为“美国新领土”

summary.en: US President Donald Trump stated that no talks with Iran are planned, while also sharing a map that depicted the Strait of Hormuz as "new US territory." Iran has maintained its stance that it will not reopen the vital waterway unless the US lifts its blockade of Iranian ports.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，目前没有与伊朗进行谈判的计划，同时他还分享了一张地图，将霍尔木兹海峡标注为“美国新领土”。伊朗坚称，除非美国解除对伊朗港口的封锁，否则不会重新开放这条重要的航道。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump has said no talks with Iran are underway and none are scheduled, as he posted a map showing the Strait of Hormuz as a new US territory.

Trump has been pressing his threat to claim sovereignty over the crucial energy waterway as the nearly six-month-old Iran war grinds on with little sign of resolution.

Trump's envoy and son-in-law Jared Kushner had said on Monday that the US and Iran were having "very positive and active conversations", but the president denied that was the case.

"There are no talks or conversations going on, or scheduled, with the Islamic Republic of Iran. The Naval Blockade remains in full force and effect," Trump wrote on his Truth Social network on Tuesday night.

"The Hormuz Strait is open and operating. All water mines have been removed or detonated."

US sources told the Agence-France Presse news agency there had been "positive" discussions with the Iranians, but added that Trump had decided to wait and asked his team not to engage until Iran was ready to make a deal.

In recent weeks, there has been a lull in fighting, though the United Arab Emirates has recently accused Iran of firing two ballistic missiles — which landed at sea — targeting "maritime navigation." Iran, however, denied firing a missile toward the UAE.

Soon after, the UAE announced that "in light of regional escalations" it was halting all trade, commercial exchanges and financial transactions with Iran.

The UAE bore the brunt of Iranian missile and drone attacks in the first period of the war, but had not reported any attacks since the US and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding in June that was meant to halt the fighting.

Earlier on Tuesday, Trump posted a map on Truth Social showing the Strait of Hormuz as a "NEW U.S. Territory".

Iran has effectively shut down the chokepoint , through which a fifth of the world's oil would usually transit, in retaliation for the war launched by the US and Israel in late February.

Trump revisited the idea again earlier in the week in comments to reporters in the Oval Office.

This is not the first time that Trump, faced with a foreign policy obstacle, has threatened to annex foreign territory.

Since returning to power in 2025, he has threatened to make Canada the 51st US state, seize Greenland and Cuba, and has even alluded to taking control of the Gaza Strip, without following through on any of these threats.

Before the Iran war erupted on 28 February, the Strait of Hormuz was an open waterway with free passage.

title.en: Founder of collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande sentenced to life in prison
title.zh: 中国倒闭房地产巨头恒大创始人被判无期徒刑

summary.en: The founder of the collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande has been sentenced to life in prison, marking a significant development in the aftermath of the company's failure, which severely impacted China's real estate sector.
summary.zh: 中国恒大地产集团的创始人因公司倒闭而被判处无期徒刑，这标志着恒大危机余波中的一个关键时刻，该危机曾震动了中国的房地产行业。

body.en:
The founder of Evergrande, the property giant at the centre of China's housing market slump, has been sentenced to life in prison and had all of his personal property confiscated.

Hui Ka Yan pleaded guilty in April to several charges, including embezzlement of assets and corporate bribery.

Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court also fined his former companies a total of 15.82bn yuan (£1.73bn; $2.35bn) over multiple crimes, including falsifying records and concealing debt.

Hui's sentencing marks a key moment in the fallout from Evergrande's collapse, which shook China's property sector and hit investors and domestic banks hard.

Hui and his businesses "seriously disrupted" the Chinese property market, resulting in significant economic losses, the court said.

Other Evergrande executives, including Hui's two sons Xu Zhijian and Xu Tenghe, were also sentenced to jail terms ranging from 22 months to 18 years, according to state media.

Once ranked Asia's richest man, Hui has seen his wealth and influence dwindle as his company unravelled.

Hui, also known as Xu Jiayin, rose from humble beginnings in rural China, where he was raised by his grandmother before venturing into property development and setting up Evergrande in 1996.

He oversaw the company's rapid rise through an aggressive expansion programme funded with large amounts of borrowed money.

Evergrande became China's biggest real estate developer, with a stock market valuation of more than $50bn (£36.7bn). Hui was once estimated to be Asia's richest person .

The firm was dealt a huge blow when Beijing introduced measures in 2020 to control debt in the country's property sector.

As the company struggled to meet interest payments on its debts it sold properties at huge discounts to stay afloat before collapsing in 2021.

In April, the court heard that the company had taken millions of dollars in pre-sale funding from potential house buyers that were not used for construction.

The money had instead been channelled to new property developments, resulting in hundreds of unfinished projects.

In March 2024, Hui was fined $6.5m and banned from China's capital market for life for his company overstating its revenue by $78bn .

Evergrande's stock market valuation shrank by 99% before its shares were removed from the Hong Kong exchange in August 2025 after more than a decade and a half of trading.

Evergrande's implosion has often been blamed for triggering a broader slump in China's property market that continues to weigh heavily on the economy.

At its height, Evergrande was the biggest firm in the country's real estate industry, which made up about a third of China's gross domestic product at the time.

The property market was a significant driver of growth and an important revenue source for local...
body.zh: 处于中国房地产市场低迷之中的房地产巨头恒大集团的创始人被判处无期徒刑，并被没收全部个人财产。 许家印四月份承认多项指控，包括贪污资产和企业贿赂。 深圳市中级人民法院还因伪造记录和隐瞒债务等多项罪行，对他以前的公司处以人民币 158.2 亿元（17.3 亿英镑；23.5 亿美元）的罚款。 许的判决标志着恒大倒闭影响的关键时刻，恒大倒闭震动了中国房地产行业，并对投资者和国内银行造成了沉重打击。 法院表示，许先生及其企业“严重扰乱”中国房地产市场，造成重大经济损失。 据官方媒体报道，恒大的其他高管，包括许志坚的两个儿子徐志坚和徐腾鹤，也被判处 22 个月至 18 年不等的监禁。 曾一度被评为亚洲首富的许氏眼睁睁地看着自己的财富和影响力随着公司的解体而逐渐减少。 许家印在中国农村出身卑微，由祖母抚养长大，随后开始涉足房地产开发，并于 1996 年创立恒大集团。 他通过利用大量借来的资金进行积极的扩张计划，见证了公司的快速崛起。 恒大成为中国最大的房地产开发商，股票市场估值超过 500 亿美元（367 亿英镑）。许氏一度被估计为亚洲首富。 当北京于2020年推出控制中国房地产行业债务的措施时，该公司遭受了巨大打击。 由于该公司难以支付债务利息，因此在 2021 年倒闭之前以大幅折扣出售了房产以维持运营。 4月份，法院获悉该公司从潜在购房者那里收取了数百万美元的预售资金，但这些资金并未用于建设。 这笔钱反而被用于新的房地产开发，导致数百个未完工的项目。 2024年3月，许先生因其公司虚报收入780亿美元而被罚款650万美元，并终身禁止进入中国资本市场。 经过十五年多的交易后，恒大股份于 2025 年 8 月从香港交易所退市之前，其股票市场估值缩水了 99%。 恒大的内爆常常被指责引发中国房地产市场更广泛的衰退，继续给经济带来沉重压力。 在鼎盛时期，恒大是中国房地产行业最大的公司，房地产行业约占当时中国国内生产总值的三分之一。 房地产市场是增长的重要推动力，也是当地的重要收入来源......

reflection.en: The sentencing of Evergrande's founder highlights the profound consequences when the pursuit of wealth overshadows ethical conduct and responsibility. Yahweh's word reminds us that the love of money can be a root of all kinds of evil, leading to devastating outcomes for individuals and entire sectors. This event serves as a somber reminder of the need for...
reflection.zh: 恒大创始人的判决凸显了当对财富的追求凌驾于道德行为和责任之上时所产生的深远后果。雅伟的话语提醒我们，贪财是万恶之根，可能给个人和整个行业带来毁灭性的结果。这一事件沉痛地提醒我们，在所有交易中都需要保持正直。

body.zh: 对母子电影“糟糕透了”的评论促使人们去电影院观看一部关于一头牛和云雀的粗糙、低科技动画在中国票房上取得了巨大成功，与《奥德赛》和《蜘蛛侠：崭新的一天》等大片并列影院收入排行榜。 《牛来》的意思是“牛来了”，这是一部 86 分钟的预算动画，讲述了新生小牛和云雀之间的关系在抽象梦境过程中发展的故事。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story reminds us that true worth and success are not always judged by conventional standards or initial human critique. Yahweh is the one who ultimately determines who rises and who falls, often surprising us with what He chooses to bless.
reflection.zh: 这个故事提醒我们，真正的价值和成功并非总是由传统标准或最初的人类评论来评判。雅伟是最终决定谁兴盛谁衰落的那一位，祂常常以出人意料的方式赐福我们。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: China’s economy showing signs that slowdown may be extending
title.zh: 中国经济放缓迹象或将延长

summary.en: China's economy is experiencing an extended slowdown, with industrial output and retail sales declining in July. This follows one of the country's weakest quarterly growth rates and increases pressure on Beijing for intervention.
summary.zh: 中国经济显示出放缓可能正在加剧的迹象，7月份工业产出和零售额均出现下滑。此前，中国经历了有史以来最疲软的季度增长率之一，这给北京带来了干预的压力。

body.en: Industrial output and retail sales slump in July after one of the country’s weakest quarterly growth rates ever China’s economy is showing signs of extending a slowdown with a slump in industrial output and retail sales in July, adding to pressure on Beijing to intervene with measures to support activity. After the world’s second largest economy posted one of its lowest quarterly growth readings on record in the three months to June, the latest figures suggest it continued to falter in July. Continue reading...
body.zh: 继中国有史以来最弱的季度增长率之一之后，7 月份工业产出和零售销售大幅下滑。随着 7 月份工业产出和零售销售的下滑，中国经济显示出持续放缓的迹象，这加大了北京方面采取干预措施支持经济活动的压力。在这个世界第二大经济体公布了截至 6 月份的三个月以来有记录以来最低的季度增长数据之一后，最新数据显示该经济体 7 月份继续下滑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As a nation faces economic headwinds, it's natural to focus on policy and human intervention. Yet, this moment can also be a reminder that Yahweh is the ultimate source of our ability to create and sustain wealth. In times of plenty or scarcity, remembering His provision helps us anchor our hope beyond fluctuating markets.
reflection.zh: 当一个国家面临经济逆风时，人们自然会关注政策和人为干预。然而，这一刻也可以提醒我们，雅伟是我们创造和维持财富能力的最终来源。无论是在富足还是匮乏之时，记住祂的供应有助于我们将希望锚定在波动市场之外。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Indonesia-China naval drill raises neutrality concerns
title.zh: 印尼与中国海军演习引发中立担忧

summary.en: Indonesia's participation in a limited naval exercise with China near Taiwan has raised questions about its long-standing nonaligned foreign policy.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚与中国海军在台湾附近举行了有限的海上演习，这引发了对其长期不结盟外交政策的担忧。

body.en:
Indonesia maintains a nonaligned foreign policy, but Jakarta's limited participation in a low-level naval exercise with China's navy near Taiwan has drawn scrutiny.

On August 12, an Indonesian frigate briefly joined a naval exercise with China's People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) in waters off Taiwan's east coast, with Taipei asking Jakarta for a reason why it joined the drill.

Indonesian Navy frigate KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai joined the PLAN guided-missile frigate Honghe for what Jakarta described as a "passing exercise." The maneuvers took place during Taiwan's annual Han Kuang military drill. 

An Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson said they were fully aware that the exercise's location "made it particularly sensitive," but stressed that its vessel's presence "was simply part of its transit route back to Indonesia." According to the Taipei Times , the Indonesian vessel was returning from Vladivostok, Russia after an exercise with the Russian navy.  

Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council condemned Beijing's "provocation" after China announced the drill on August 11. Taipei also requested "further details from the Indonesian government" from its Ministry of Foreign Affairs.  

Beijing considers Taiwan to be Chinese territory and has vowed to "reunite" the self-ruled island with the mainland, by using force if necessary . The People's Liberation Army has ratcheted up pressure on Taiwan with frequent military exercises around the island, especially since former US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taipei in 2022.

Amid reactions from Taipei and Washington, the Indonesian Navy stated that its activities with the Chinese Navy were "not warfighting activities in nature" and "not intended as combat training."

Ying-Yu Lin, an associate professor at Taiwan's Tamkang University Graduate Institute of International Affairs and Strategic Studies, told DW that the Chinese exercise with Indonesia had little tactical significance.

"It wasn't as practical as a joint maritime drill, but China wanted to claim its capability in the waters," he said.

However, Ratih Kabinawa, a visiting research fellow at the Japan Institute of International Affairs focusing on Taiwan-Indonesia ties, told DW that regardless of the significance of the drills, Indonesia should have expected some reaction from Taiwan .

"Like it or not, Indonesia is now dragged into this kind of geopolitical gambit," she said.

Kabinawa added that passing exercises were among the lowest-level naval activities yet used by China to justify its intimidation of Taiwan.

"Indonesia must also exercise caution in this regard," she said, adding that Jakarta should "not to be too naive," to assume that its participation in a "regular exercise" with China would not cause concern in...
body.zh: 印度尼西亚维持不结盟的外交政策，但雅加达有限地参与与中国海军在台湾附近举行的低级别海军演习，引起了密切关注。 8月12日，一艘印度尼西亚护卫舰短暂参加了与中国人民解放军海军在台湾东海岸附近海域举行的海军演习，台北向雅加达询问其参加演习的原因。 印度尼西亚海军护卫舰 KRI I Gusti Ngurah Rai 与中国海军导弹护卫舰红河号一起进行了雅加达所说的“穿越演习”。这次演习是在台湾一年一度的汉光军演期间进行的。 印度尼西亚外交部发言人表示，他们完全意识到演习地点“使其特别敏感”，但强调其船只的存在“只是其返回印度尼西亚的过境路线的一部分”。据《台北时报》报道，这艘印尼舰艇在与俄罗斯海军演习后正从俄罗斯符拉迪沃斯托克返回。 中国8月11日宣布演习后，台湾陆委会谴责北京的“挑衅”。台北还要求外交部“提供更多细节”。 北京认为台湾是中国领土，并誓言要让这个自治岛屿与大陆“统一”，必要时会使用武力。特别是自美国前众议院议长南希·佩洛西 2022 年访问台北以来，解放军在台湾频繁进行军事演习，加大了对台湾的压力。 在台北和华盛顿的反应中，印度尼西亚海军表示，其与中国海军的活动“本质上不是战斗活动”，并且“无意进行战斗训练”。 台湾淡江大学国际事务与战略研究所副教授林英宇告诉德国之声，中国与印尼的演习没有什么战术意义。 他说：“这不像联合海上演习那么实际，但中国希望宣示其在该海域的能力。” 不过，日本国际问题研究所研究台印尼关系的客座研究员拉蒂·卡比纳瓦(Ratih Kabinawa)告诉德国之声，无论演习的意义如何，印尼都应该预料到台湾会做出一些反应。 “无论你喜欢与否，印度尼西亚现在都被拖入了这种地缘政治游戏，”她说。 卡比纳瓦补充说，此次演习是中国迄今为止用来证明其恐吓台湾合理性的最低级别的海军活动之一。 她说：“印度尼西亚在这方面也必须保持谨慎。”她补充说，雅加达应该“不要太天真”，认为参加与中国的“定期演习”不会引起人们的担忧……

reflection.en: In a world of complex geopolitical dynamics, nations often strive to maintain peace and neutrality. Indonesia's efforts to navigate its foreign policy amidst regional tensions reflect the ongoing challenge of living at peace with all, as far as it depends on them. This pursuit requires wisdom and a steadfast commitment to de-escalation and understanding.
reflection.zh: 在复杂的地缘政治格局中，各国常努力维持和平与中立。印度尼西亚在区域紧张局势中努力调整其外交政策，反映了在力所能及的范围内与所有人和平相处的持续挑战。这种追求需要智慧和对缓和局势、增进理解的坚定承诺。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: From ‘elation’ to ‘terrible news’ in 10 minutes: how the confusion over missing bushwalker Lily Hooper unfolded

summary.en: The 18-year-old’s body was found in Nattai national park on Thursday – but initial police messages indicated she was alive Teen hiker Lily Hooper found dead as NSW police apologise for miscommunication ‘born of elation’ Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast...

body.en: The 18-year-old’s body was found in Nattai national park on Thursday – but initial police messages indicated she was alive Teen hiker Lily Hooper found dead as NSW police apologise for miscommunication ‘born of elation’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Police have blamed dense bushland and radio confusion for wrongly reporting to 18-year-old Lily Hooper’s parents, the New South Wales premier and the media that the missing bushwalker had been found alive. Hooper had last been seen on 12 August after leaving home for a hike in the rugged bushland of Nattai national park, 90km south-west of Sydney . She was reported missing that night, triggering a multi-agency search involving nearly 1,000 people, including hundreds of volunteers. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周四，纳泰国家公园发现了这名 18 岁女孩的尸体，但最初的警方消息表明她还活着 青少年徒步旅行者莉莉·胡珀 (Lily Hooper) 被发现死亡，新南威尔士州警方为“出于兴高采烈”的沟通不畅而道歉 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 警方指责茂密的丛林和无线电混乱，错误地向 18 岁莉莉·胡珀 (Lily Hooper) 的父母、新南威尔士州州长和媒体报告失踪的丛林徒步旅行者已被发现活着。胡珀最后一次被人看见是在8月12日，当时他离家去悉尼西南90公里的纳泰国家公园崎岖的丛林远足。据报道，她当晚失踪，引发了多机构的搜寻，涉及近 1,000 人，其中包括数百名志愿者。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Missing teen hiker Lily Hooper found dead as NSW police apologise for miscommunication ‘born of elation’
title.zh: 失踪青少年徒步旅行者莉莉·胡珀被发现死亡，新南威尔士州警方为“喜悦中产生的”误报致歉

summary.en: An 18-year-old hiker, Lily Hooper, was found dead after being reported missing. New South Wales police initially received a report that she was alive but corrected this within ten minutes, apologizing for the miscommunication.
summary.zh: 18岁徒步旅行者莉莉·胡珀失踪后被发现死亡。新南威尔士州警方最初收到她还活着的报告，但在十分钟内纠正了这一错误，并为误报致歉。

body.en: Initial report from ‘thick and dense terrain’ where Hooper was located was she had been found alive but within 10 minutes a ‘more accurate account’ was relayed to police Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The body of missing 18-year-old bushwalker Lily Hooper has been found in a remote New South Wales national park more than a week after she set out on her hike. Police have apologised “unreservedly” for wrongly suggesting Hooper had been alive when she was found by SES search volunteers off the walking trail in the state’s southern highlands on Thursday morning. Continue reading...
body.zh: 胡珀所在的“茂密地形”的初步报告称，她被发现时还活着，但 10 分钟内，警方收到了一份“更准确的报告”。 失踪的 18 岁丛林徒步旅行者莉莉·胡珀 (Lily Hooper) 的尸体在她出发徒步旅行一周多后，在偏远的新南威尔士州国家公园被发现。周四早上，SES 搜索志愿者在该州南部高地的步行道上发现胡珀时，警方错误地暗示胡珀还活着，警方对此“毫无保留”地道歉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic loss of Lily Hooper, compounded by the brief, false hope, brings profound sorrow. In such moments of deep grief and dashed expectations, we hold onto Yahweh's promise that a day will come when every tear is wiped away, and death, mourning, crying, and pain will be no more. This hope anchors us when earthly realities are most heartbreaking.
reflection.zh: 莉莉·胡珀的悲剧性逝去，加上短暂的虚假希望，带来了深切的悲痛。在如此深重的悲伤和破灭的期待中，我们紧紧抓住雅伟的应许：有一天，他将擦去所有的眼泪，死亡、悲哀、哭号和疼痛都将不再有。当世间的现实最令人心碎时，这份盼望成为我们的锚。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Drug-dealing, makeshift weapons and a ‘culture of fear’ at Villawood detention centre, report warns
title.zh: 报告警告称，维拉伍德拘留中心存在贩毒、自制武器和“恐惧文化”

summary.en: An ombudsman's report has raised serious concerns about conditions at the Villawood detention center, citing drug-dealing, makeshift weapons, a culture of fear, prolonged detention of children, insufficient staffing, and hazardous building damage.
summary.zh: 一份监察员报告警告称，维拉伍德拘留中心存在贩毒、自制武器和“恐惧文化”，并对儿童长期拘留、人手不足以及建筑物危险损坏等问题表示担忧。

body.en: Prolonged detention of children, insufficient staffing and hazardous damage to buildings are among the ombudsman’s concerns Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Drugs are being openly dealt inside Villawood detention centre; makeshift weapons are being manufactured amid intimidation, standover tactics and a “culture of fear”; people are sleeping outside under CCTV cameras for their own safety; and children are being kept from going to school, a scathing report from the independent monitor has found. The commonwealth’s National Preventive Mechanism issued the report based on a three-day visit in March this year. A total of 428 people were held in Villawood at the time, including children. Some 78 beds were offline because of damage still not repaired from a fire three years ago. Continue reading...
body.zh: 监察员关注儿童长期拘留、人员不足和建筑物危险损坏等问题关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客以获取最新动态获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客维拉伍德拘留中心内正在公开交易毒品；在恐吓、孤立战术和“恐惧文化”的背景下制造临时武器；为了自身安全，人们在闭路电视摄像机下睡在外面；独立监察员的一份措辞严厉的报告发现，儿童无法上学。英联邦国家预防机制根据今年三月为期三天的访问发布了这份报告。当时维拉伍德共有 428 人被关押，其中包括儿童。由于三年前的火灾造成的损坏仍未修复，约有 78 个床位无法使用。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The report on the Villawood detention center highlights the profound vulnerability of those held there, particularly children and strangers, and the systemic failures in their care. Yahweh reminds us that how we treat the least among us reflects our heart towards Him, calling us to compassion and justice for all.
reflection.zh: 关于维拉伍德拘留中心的报告突显了被拘留者的极度脆弱，特别是儿童和陌生人，以及他们在看护方面存在的系统性失职。雅伟提醒我们，我们如何对待最卑微的人，反映了我们对祂的心，呼召我们对所有人施以怜悯和公义。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: More than 1,000 birds found dead in three mass mortality events amid ‘significant’ H5 escalation in Australia
title.zh: 澳大利亚H5病毒显著升级，三起大规模死亡事件致逾千只鸟类死亡

summary.en: Over 1,000 birds have been found dead across three mass mortality events in Australia, linked to a significant escalation of the H5 virus. South Australian premier Peter Malinauskas confirmed no detections in poultry, livestock, or mammals so far.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚发生了三起大规模鸟类死亡事件，超过1000只鸟类死亡，与H5病毒的显著升级有关。南澳大利亚州州长彼得·马利瑙斯卡斯证实，目前尚未在家禽、牲畜或哺乳动物中检测到该病毒。

body.en: South Australian premier Peter Malinauskas says there have still been no detections in poultry or livestock and no mass deaths involving mammals Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The South Australian premier, Peter Malinauskas, has declared a “significant escalation” in H5 bird flu in the state after the detection of three mass mortality events involving more than 1,000 greater crested terns. Malinauskas said the cause of the deaths was presumed to be H5 bird flu. Continue reading...
body.zh: 南澳大利亚州州长彼得·马利纳斯卡斯 (Peter Malinauskas) 表示，尚未发现家禽或牲畜的病例，也没有涉及哺乳动物的大规模死亡。 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 南澳大利亚州州长彼得·马利纳斯卡斯 (Peter Malinauskas) 在发现三起涉及 1,000 多只大凤头燕鸥的大规模死亡事件后，宣布该州 H5 禽流感“显着升级”。马利瑙斯卡斯说，死因推测是H5禽流感。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic mass deaths of birds in Australia remind us of the profound brokenness within creation. Yahweh's word tells us that the whole creation groans under the weight of suffering, longing for renewal. These events stir a deep sorrow, reflecting the pain of a world not yet fully restored.
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚大量鸟类死亡的悲剧事件提醒我们，受造界深陷破碎之中。雅伟的话语告诉我们，整个受造界都在痛苦中呻吟，渴望更新。这些事件激起我们内心深处的悲伤，反映出这个尚未完全复原的世界所承受的痛苦。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Albanese wanted 'full accountability' from Israel. Instead, Australia is 'outraged'
title.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯希望以色列承担“全部责任”。相反，澳大利亚感到“愤怒”

summary.en: Outrage over Israel's response to aid worker Zomi Frankcom's killing is the latest flashpoint in a relationship that's no longer warm.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Israel's decision not to pursue criminal proceedings over the killing of Australian aid worker Zomi Frankcom has sparked "outrage" from the federal government, signalling a new low for relations between the two countries.

The decision comes after almost three years of increasingly strained ties, with Australia moving from backing Israel after the October 7 attacks to i mposing sanctions on Israeli government ministers and recognising a Palestinian state.

Despite previously conceding there had been "serious failures", the Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) on Wednesday announced it would not prosecute those responsible for the death of Frankcom and six of her World Central Kitchen colleagues in an IDF strike in Gaza in April 2024.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong said the decision "falls far short of the accountability we expect" in some of her most critical comments against Israel since the Gaza war began.

Asked about Australia's relationship with Israel, Wong said it was facing a "difficult time".

title.en: Australia's new media bargaining laws put pressure on tech platforms to pay for news

body.en:
The Australian government passed legislation on Thursday that will force tech giants to pay millions of dollars in levies if they fail to strike commercial deals with local media outlets for news on their platforms.

The News Bargaining Incentive taxes the companies 2.5 per cent on their advertising revenues unless they strike agreements.

Proceeds from the scheme would be directed to local Australian news outlets, whose content helps drive user engagement and advertising revenue on the tech firms' platforms.

The levy applies to Meta, Alphabet's Google, TikTok and Microsoft's LinkedIn, covering companies with a "significant" social media or search service in Australia, and local advertising revenue exceeding $250 million.

Platforms can avoid the charge by reaching agreements with at least eight different publishers by the end of their reporting period. The value of those deals would be offset against their levy liability.

The deals must support the production of news content or relate to news content produced by the publishers being made available online by the platform, the legislation said.

Spending with large publishers carries a 150 per cent offset, while spending with small and medium-sized outlets carries a 200 per cent offset.

"The legislation is here, and the message to platforms to pursue commercial deals is clear. Deals will need to be finalised before the end of a digital platform's financial reporting period to be used to offset their liability in that period," the government said in a statement.

"This is an important day for Australian news businesses and Australian journalism."

The passage of the News Bargaining Incentive comes one day after parliament passed laws restricting gambling advertisements.

body.en:
Authorities in South Australia have identified three mass mortality bird events. The events involve more than 1,000 crested terns, which authorities "presumed" died of the H5N1 bird flu.

The deaths, detected on Wednesday, occurred on remote islands including Troubridge Island, as well as North Page and South Page close to Kangaroo Island.

State government surveillance teams discovered the dead birds, and are considered a "significant escalation" of bird flu cases in the state, South Australian Premier Peter Malinauskas said in an address to the SA parliament.

"The loss of more than 1,000 birds is deeply concerning, and the state government is treating these events with the utmost seriousness," he said.

"Of particular concern, we are also investigating a suspected case involving a little penguin from Kangaroo Island."

Malinauskas said that no similar mortality events had been reported in mammals. He also noted that H5N1 had not yet been detected in any poultry or livestock.

A surveillance team found 28 little penguins had died, along with three crested terns, a week after the H5 bird flu strain was first detected in the state.

body.en:
An eight-day search for a missing teenager has ended after her family was initially wrongly told their daughter was still alive.

Police said they mistakenly gave Lily Hooper's family the news after the 18-year-old's body was found in dense bushland in Nattai National Park, in NSW's Southern Highlands.

An SES volunteer found Hooper's body about 11.30am on Thursday, but a communication breakdown led to incorrect reporting to her family, NSW Police assistant commissioner Joseph Cassar said.

"[The family] were informed [of] initial information the searchers believed she was alive, and that's what was communicated," Cassar told reporters.

"Within eight-to-10 minutes we were able to give them an update, which was a more accurate account."

The teenager from Oakdale, in Sydney's south-west, did not return that evening and could not be contacted on her mobile phone, triggering a wide-scale search.

Her car was discovered at the Bonnum Pic trailhead the same night she went missing, but Cassar said the teenager was found a long way from her vehicle.

In state parliament, NSW Premier Chris Minns was informed during budget estimates that Hooper had been found, and initially announced that she had been found alive, the ABC reported.

"I apologise to the committee, but it seems as if the early advice was wrong," he said.

"This is obviously devastating, and I'm just profoundly sad for her family and all those concerned."

He said in a follow-up statement afterwards that he had received incorrect advice and had "genuinely believed I was sharing good news".

"My deepest condolences are with Lily's family. I am profoundly sorry to think that anything I said may have added to their heartbreak at an already devastating time," the premier said in the statement reported by several media outlets.

On Tuesday, Hooper's family had issued a statement via NSW Police saying they were "absolutely devastated that our beloved daughter Lily is missing".

"We would like to thank all the emergency services and volunteers for their support and continued commitment to the search, not only during the day but throughout the night," the statement said.

"We desperately want to bring Lily home safe, and we ask as the search continues, to keep our family and Lily in your thoughts.

"We also ask for privacy and understanding as our family navigates this unimaginable situation."

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Opposition leader Angus Taylor have paid tribute to Hooper.

Speaking from parliament, Albanese said Hooper had been "taken from her family, the community and our nation far too young".

body.en:
More than 5.3 million Australians will receive higher social security payments within weeks under the latest round of indexation.

The new pay boosts will take effect from 20 September, increasing the rates of the pension, JobSeeker, Youth Allowance, Parenting Payment, ABSTUDY, and Rent Assistance payments.

"An extra $4 billion of cost-of-living relief will begin to flow to over 5.3 million Australians," Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said.

"Whether it's paying the rent, putting food on the table or covering everyday bills, this extra support will help Australians on income support make ends meet.

"We'll continue to make sure the system is there to support those who need it most, ensuring that everyone can make ends meet and no one gets left behind."

However, Cassandra Goldie, CEO of the Australian Council of Social Service, said that "while every extra dollar counts", routine indexation was not enough to lift people out of poverty and deprivation.

"People receiving JobSeeker are struggling to afford three meals a day and keep a roof over their heads," she said in a statement provided to SBS News.

"The government must deliver a significant real increase to JobSeeker, Youth Allowance, Parenting Payment and related supports so that people don't have to go without the essentials."

Social security payments are generally indexed twice a year to maintain their value and match changes in the cost of living and average wages. Here is how much each payment will increase by.

The maximum rates for age pension will be lifted by $36.80 to $1,237.70 a fortnight for single pensioners. Couples will receive a $55.60 increase to their combined fortnightly payment, bringing it to $1,866.00.

Pay rates for non-resident single pensioners will increase by $5 a fortnight, while partnered non-resident pensions will increase by $1.70 a fortnight each.

For singles without children who receive JobSeeker payments, the highest rate increases by $16.20 to $833.70 every two weeks. For singles with dependent children, the rate will increase by $17.30 to $892.80.

The rate for couples will rise by $14.80 per person, bringing the fortnightly payment to $763 each.

Parenting payment recipients will also see an increase, with maximum rates rising by $20.90 to $1,087.20 fortnightly for singles and by $14.80 to $763 for partnered recipients.

One million renters will also receive increased Commonwealth Rent Assistance rates.

body.en:
Slain Australian aid worker Zomi Frankcom's family say they are "deeply disappointed" by Israel's decision not to pursue criminal charges over the strike that killed her.

It comes after the Australian government heavily criticised the call and hauled in Israeli ambassador Hillel Newman for a diplomatic dressing down but rejected calls to expel him.

Israel's military announced overnight it had found no suspicion of criminal misconduct in the April 2024 strike that killed Frankcom and six of her colleagues in Gaza, saying it would not look into it further.

Her brother Mal Frankcom said announcing the decision on World Humanitarian Day was "an insult to my sister's memory".

"We and the families of the six other World Central Kitchen aid workers have been waiting for justice for over two years, hoping and calling for an independent criminal investigation," he said in the statement.
